repurposed.title: The AI Replacement Myth 🤯 (Why devs are safer than you think)
repurposed.caption:
Are developers actually getting replaced by AI in 2026? Here's the brutal truth from 10+ years building software.

AI won't replace programmers — but programmers using AI will replace those who don't.

Key takeaways:
⚡ Syntax is commoditized; architectural intuition is king.
⚡ Prompting is just distributed systems modeling in plain English.
⚡ The real 10x engineers are building autonomous feedback loops.

Save this reel for your next technical interview prep! 💾

repurposed.title: Why AI will not replace senior software engineers
repurposed.caption:
The conversation around AI replacing developers fundamentally misunderstands what engineering actually is.

Writing code was never the bottleneck.

The real job has always been:
1. Translating ambiguous business problems into verifiable state machines
2. Designing resilient distributed data boundaries
3. Ensuring fault-tolerant rollback capabilities

AI won't replace programmers — but programmers using AI will quickly replace those who don't.

What skills are you actively upgrading this quarter? Let's discuss in the comments below. 👇
